# A book whose top-level accounts are all held in CAD, and whose `company`
# block states `base_currency: "HKD"`.
#
# The `company` block's `base_currency:` comes before the currency the
# top-level accounts share (Q-042), so this book is kept in HKD.
#
# What this fixture produces: Assets and Equity in CAD, and the book-level
# custom key base_currency = HKD. Imported with --include-business-objects,
# which is what imports a `company` block.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_currency_a_book_is_kept_in.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

company
	name: "A Company Keeping Its Books In Hong Kong Dollars"
	base_currency: "HKD"
